mechanism_claims.entity_scope: Lf-KR compared with LfcinB6 and KR-12-a4
mechanism_claims.claim_text: Lf-KR shows stronger bacterial membrane depolarization in S. aureus and concentration-dependent dye leakage from EYPE/EYPG model vesicles, supporting direct membrane-disruption evidence without assigning a single pore model.
direct_assay_types: calcein leakage from EYPE/EYPG large unilamellar vesicles
mechanism_claims.limitations: Supports membrane perturbation/permeabilization; exact kinetic/percent values are figure-based and not converted into tabular activity rows.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: CD and model-structure results support alpha-helical character for Lf-KR in membrane-mimicking conditions and higher hydrophobicity/net charge than parental fragments.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Structural/model context is not by itself a direct antimicrobial mechanism and is kept bounded.

mechanism_claims.entity_scope: Lf-KR and comparators in LPS-stimulated RAW264.7 cells
mechanism_claims.claim_text: LPS-binding, NO/TNF-alpha release, and iNOS/TNF-alpha mRNA assays support anti-inflammatory functional activity at non-cytotoxic test concentrations.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Functional anti-inflammatory evidence is not converted into antimicrobial MIC/MBEC rows.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Table 5 MBEC endpoints plus CLSM live/dead imaging support anti-biofilm activity against preformed multidrug-resistant P. aeruginosa biofilm.
mechanism_claims.limitations: MBEC values are recorded in activity evidence; CLSM imaging is qualitative support and not an exact quantitative kill table.
